title: Demon and Bound Blonde
description: A blue demonic figure with large curved horns and glowing eyes stands behind a beautiful blonde woman, holding a golden chain attached to her. She wears a tight blue and black corset dress with red lacing and looks forward with a neutral expression.
prompt: A muscular blue-skinned demon with large curved horns, glowing white eyes and sharp teeth stands behind a beautiful long-haired blonde woman in a dark stone archway. The demon holds a thick golden chain connected to her. She wears a tight blue satin corset dress with black lace and red ribbon lacing. The stone arch is covered in carved runes and snakes, dripping with purple liquid, dark fantasy atmosphere, dramatic lighting
